title: Nintendo reports that operating profit more than doubled last quarter despite lower net sales
description: Nintendo had a strong quarter – for the three-month period spanning April to June, the company saw operating profit skyrocket with a 150% increase. It went from JPY 56.9 billion for the same period last year to JPY 142.5 billion (this converts to around $902 million). And this is despite net sales declining 9.5% to JPY 517.8 billion ($3.28 billion). How did this happen? Well, tariff refunds in the US worked out to around $300 million. The company writes that “the tariffs related to the refunds were primarily borne by the company rather than passed on to consumers through product prices.”...

title: Apple's offer to get Chinese DRAM on the cheap denied by CXMT
description: Apple is reportedly short on DRAM just weeks away from its iPhone 18 unveiling, and scrambling to find more stock. Desperate times call for desperate measures, and Apple reportedly turned to Chinese RAM manufacturer CXMT for the additional stock. First, Apple had to ask the Federal Government for permission to buy DRAM from CXMT, as it's a US-blacklisted company. CXMT sells memory to Xiaomi, along with other Chinese companies, but US companies need an explicit permission to do business with it. Second, Apple has supposedly asked CXMT for a lower price for the DRAM, which ended up being the...

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 vs. Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra
description: Now that Samsung has a new form factor in the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8, it is only natural for at least some prospective buyers to be weighing it against the more established foldable design in the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra. After all, the difference in price between the two isn't huge, so the decision has to be based on other considerations. So, let's look into some of the finer points in this comparison together. Perhaps we might just help you figure out which is the best Fold for you. Table of Contents: Design Display Battery Life Charging Speaker Test ...

title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE passes through the FCC
description: Samsung's upcoming Galaxy S26 FE has now received the official nod from the FCC, which means it probably is launching next month, just like its predecessor did last year. Interestingly, while the Galaxy S26 FE has an Exynos chipset and modem, it uses a Qualcomm chip for Wi-Fi, unlike the S25 FE which was all-Exynos. The new phone has support for 45W fast wired charging, just like its predecessor. It also supports wireless charging, NFC, Wi-Fi 6, and satellite connectivity. While the FCC certification doesn’t reveal the chipset powering it, this has been rumored to be the Exynos...

title: Sunbird, the Android app that does iMessage, returns from the dead with an open beta
description: The EU has been throwing its weight around, trying to force interoperability between the major digital platforms. But companies can work at the issue too – companies like Sunbird, which may as well be called “phoenix” since it’s back from the dead. Sunbird has built an Android app that promises proper iMessage support. Is that still necessary now that Apple devices support RCS? The company points out that RCS messages still appear in a green bubble to iPhone users. Also, some features like reactions, replies and iMessage group features still don’t work properly when RCS gets...

title: Galaxy Z Fold8 duo and Galaxy Z Flip8 become Samsung's most pre-ordered foldables in Europe
description: Samsung has announced that the Galaxy Z Fold8, the Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, and the Galaxy Z Flip8 - unveiled on July 22 - have set a new record as they become its most pre-ordered foldables in Europe. The Korean company said that the new Galaxy Z series foldables surpassed the previous pre-order record by more than 17% in Europe, with pre-orders still open until 11:59 PM on August 6. Furthermore, Samsung said the combined pre-orders of the Galaxy Z Fold8 and Fold8 Ultra increased 70% year-on-year compared to last year's Fold7, with the Fold8 alone accounting for 40% of total European...

title: Detailed Google Pixel Watch 5 leak shows off key watch features
description: Another day, another Google Pixel Watch 5 leak. This one focuses more on the watch’s functionality rather than its looks – if you want a peep at the latter, check out the leaked official renders, which show the watch in four colors. Google Pixel Watch 5 in: Matte Black • Polished Silver • Satin Pyrite • Champagne Gold The four colors are: Matte Black, Polished Silver, Satin Pyrite and Champagne Gold. Note that the watch will come in two sizes as usual, 41mm and 45mm, and for whatever reason the 45mm version will not be available in Champagne Gold. There will be a variety of...

title: The Galaxy Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra and Z Flip8 launch globally tomorrow
description: Starting tomorrow, the Galaxy Z Fold8, Z Fold8 Ultra and Z Flip8 will be available in 106 markets worldwide. If you haven’t pre-ordered one (last chance today!), you will be able to pick one up from a local carrier, retailer, Samsung Experience Store and the Samsung.com online store. Each Galaxy Z foldable comes with a free 6-month trial of Google AI Pro (this includes 5TB of cloud storage), which is valued at $120. title: HMD 215 4G and HMD 235 4G listed by online retailer, HMD 3210 joins them
description: HMD is in a weird spot – it had a license to build Nokia-branded feature phones, which was supposed to end in 2026, but the company received a 3-year extension. However, it seems that this extension applies only to some regions. HMD 215 4G in Black The company recently unveiled several Nokia feature phones with an AI button. Among them were the Nokia 215 4G (2026) and the Nokia 235 4G (2026). Now an online retailer has listed the HMD 215 4G and HMD 235 4G, which appear to be identical, down to the AI button. title: Google's rumored Pixel Glow feature may launch as HiLight, supported colors leak
description: Google's upcoming Pixel 11 Pro series will come with an RGB LED notification light integrated into the rear camera bar. The feature was previously rumored to be called Pixel Glow, but a new leak suggests it could be marketed under the HiLight branding. Tipster Evan Blass recently shared new promotional images of the Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro Fold that reference the RGB LED light on the rear camera bar. Notably, the marketing materials refer to the feature as HiLight, rather than the previously rumored Pixel Glow. As per the leaked promotional images, the HiLight feature will...

title: Xiaomi Redmi Note 17 in for review
description: Today we have with us the new Redmi Note 17, which is the newest member of Xiaomi’s Redmi Note series and the successor to last year’s Redmi Note 15. It is also functionally identical to the Poco M8 Power that was launched recently. The Redmi Note series has always prioritized offering great value by combining premium features with an affordable price. However, things are going to be different this year. The Redmi Note 17 is the latest victim of the ongoing memory crisis thanks to Uncle Sam's invention, and as a result, some of the specifications have been dialed back compared to last...

title: Redmi K100 Pro Max will pack a 9,070mAh battery
description: Ahead of the Redmi K100 Pro series launch on August 11, the company has revealed the battery specifications of the K100 Pro Max. Redmi has also shared official renders of the smartphone in its white color option. Redmi has confirmed that the K100 Pro Max will pack a 9,070mAh battery with support for 100W wired and 50W wireless charging. The smartphone will also support 27W wired reverse charging and 22.5W wireless reverse charging. Redmi had previously revealed that the K100 Pro Max would feature a 6.9-inch AMOLED display with a 185Hz refresh rate and up to 4,500 nits of peak...

title: Redmi Note 17 launched in India with 8000mAh battery and Snapdragon 4 Gen 4
description: Xiaomi has announced the Redmi Note 17 in India. Successor to the Redmi Note 15 from last year, the new model brings a much larger battery capacity and a bigger display, but compromises in other areas to maintain price parity in the current market. The Redmi Note 17 has a new 8000mAh battery, which is 45% bigger than the one on the Redmi Note 15. You get 45W of wired fast charging as well as 22.5W of reversed wired charging. The new phone also has a bigger (and flatter) 7.0-inch 120Hz AMOLED display with Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection. However, concessions have been made...

title: Here's when the Samsung Galaxy S26 series will receive One UI 9 Beta 5
description: Samsung released the first One UI 9 beta update for the Galaxy S26 series in May, with the last beta build for the S26 trio rolled out more than three weeks ago. Beta users have been eagerly waiting for the fifth One UI 9 beta, and Samsung has revealed when it will be released. Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra A Beta Operations Manager on the Samsung Community Forum said that the One UI 9 Beta 5 update for the Galaxy S26 series is scheduled to release next week without mentioning the date, so expect it to arrive any time between August 10 and 15. description: vivo today introduced the vivo S2 in India, marking the comeback of the S series to the Asian country after a hiatus of seven years, as vivo didn't launch any S series smartphone in India after the vivo S1, which was launched in India in August 2019. vivo says the S2 "has been thoughtfully crafted for young consumers who value style, creativity, intelligent experiences, and meaningful innovation," and "with its premium design and advanced imaging capabilities, the vivo S2 delivers a well-rounded experience that complements today’s dynamic lifestyles." title: Samsung's next smartwatch doesn’t run Wear OS, new report claims
description: Samsung is working on a new smartwatch that will not be running Wear OS, according to a new report. This will allegedly slot in between the Galaxy Fit and the Galaxy Watch FE in price, and it's codenamed Galaxy Aero. It runs RTOS and references to it have been found inside the Galaxy Wearable app's code, which describes it as a watch with a screen. It's likely that this will have the standard set of sensors you’d expect from a smartwatch, and given the fact that it's not running Wear OS, it should have week-long (or even weeks-long) battery life. title: vivo V80 Lite 5G is on the way and could be a rebrand job
description: vivo is working on the V80 Lite 5G, the first member of the V80 family, which according to a recent rumor should become official around the middle of this month. The V80 Lite 5G has been spotted in the Google Play Console with the model numbers V2576, V2643, and V2644. Interestingly, the V2576 model number is also listed in the Google Play Console for the vivo S2, which is launching in India on August 6. title: Huawei unveils 2026 MateBook Fold with Kirin X90 Plus SoC
description: Huawei unveiled the MateBook Fold Ultimate Design, its foldable laptop, in May last year, followed by the Extraordinary Master Edition a few months later. The company has now introduced the 2026 MateBook Fold, featuring an upgraded chipset. The 2026 Huawei MateBook Fold Extraordinary Master Edition is powered by the Kirin X90 Plus chipset and can be configured with up to 32GB of RAM and 2TB of storage. While most of the hardware remains unchanged from last year's model, Huawei has refreshed the laptop's design. It retains the 18-inch dual-layer LTPO OLED foldable display that offers...

title: TCL P80 and P80 Pro renders, specs, and prices leak
description: TCL is working on a couple of new smartphones, which it plans to launch in Europe. Official-looking renders of both have been leaked today by a reliable source. The TCL P80 is allegedly powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7300 Elite chipset, paired with 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. It has a 50MP main camera with OIS, an 8MP ultrawide, a 32MP selfie camera, and a 5,000 mAh battery. title: Huawei launches the feather-light 12-inch MatePad Pro 2026
description: Alongside the nova 16 SE smartphone, today Huawei also announced the MatePad Pro 2026 tablet. It has a 12-inch OLED screen with 3036x1952 resolution and 1,600-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the Kirin T93 or Kirin T93A chipset, depending on the model - the former is built into the standard version, while the latter is reserved for the Enjoy Edition, which is cheaper. The tablet runs HarmonyOS 6.1, and you can have it with 12GB of RAM and 256GB or 512GB of storage.
